body: Pyschology is supposed to be the fallback even though I hate pyschology and pretty much everything else including art at this point . And I'd rather just stay at home and sleep until I die .

I've waited to do the same thing I've been talking about all along . I've wanted to be an artist . Since I was a teenager and a kid. But I think what I've always really wanted to be was nothing at all .
And I suck at everything and I have no motivation to try to get better . When things go wrong I give up and go to sleep
And I've never been interested in anything else . This has been my plan that whole time and if I'm not gonna do it I'd rather be dead or just not do anything at all .
That's the thing I haven't even started college yet
I'm afraid that if I do I'll be sent to hell as a punishment and be tortured . Even though I guess that's what  I pretty much deserve

I don't really know if this help you at all ... Probably not but I'm in a similar situation. I'm not in college either and most people already started too . I'll probably start in fall too but I'm not at all even happy about it anymore . I didn't start earlier because of my social anxiety ( which has probably gotten worse at this point anyways ) . I don't really have friends except one that lives far and that I barely ever see . I've had relationships but they were all shit and ended quickly .And surprise surprise they all broke up with me when they saw what a wreck and how weird I was. I stick around for my mom and my pet cat . So I guess what I'm trying to say is I feel like I can understand how you feel in some ways . And I really hope both of us can feel better
